description: This Java class 'EdgeConsumerStats' manages and logs statistics counters related to edge message processing in the Thingsboard platform, including message counts and types of edge notifications.

classes.name: EdgeConsumerStats
classes.description: A class that tracks and logs various statistics related to edge message processing, including counters for total messages, notifications, high priority messages, updates, sync requests/responses, and component lifecycle events.

methods.name: EdgeConsumerStats
methods.description: Constructor that initializes various statistics counters using a StatsFactory.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Adds a StatsCounter to the internal list and returns it.

methods.name: log(ToEdgeNotificationMsg msg)
methods.description: Logs a notification message, incrementing counters based on message type.

methods.name: log(ToEdgeMsg msg)
methods.description: Logs a general edge message, incrementing total and notification counters.

methods.name: printStats
methods.description: Outputs current statistics if total message count is greater than zero.
